block.description: Monitor RSS feeds and trigger workflows when new items are published
block.longDescription: Subscribe to any RSS or Atom feed and automatically trigger your workflow when new content is published. Perfect for monitoring blogs, news sites, podcasts, and any content that publishes an RSS feed.

subBlocks.title: Feed URL
subBlocks.description: The URL of the RSS or Atom feed to monitor

subBlocks.title: Setup Instructions
subBlocks.default:
1. Enter the URL of any RSS or Atom feed you want to monitor
2. The feed will be checked every minute for new items
3. When a new item is published, your workflow will be triggered with the item data
